question: Is Grok 4.7 faster or better than 4.20 for the mod, and do mood-specific voice directions, a sex-scene change rule, and a repeat hint fix the issues seen in her logs?
evidence_status: Harness runs against OpenRouter on captured game data: Experiment 31's 31 frozen scenes, her real Nov 6 evening (36 events, scenes/nov6-evening.json), and the Nov 12 play-test's 8 WickedWhims sex_scene events (scenes/playtest-sex-sequence.json), replayed in order with in-RAM memory recording. Voice judgments are Gemini's, blind. Not yet in the real game.
how_to_rerun: python3.15 lab.py exp32 text | replay {nov6,sex} [--models --variants --reps] | analyze [--show] | voice-moods

grok_4_7.public_stats: OpenRouter live provider stats (last 30 min, default reasoning): grok-4.20 first token p50 0.47-0.62 s at 94-98 tok/s; grok-4.7 p50 2.4-3.6 s (p90 up to 22 s) at 54-68 tok/s. Price $2/$6 vs $1.25/$2.50 per M tokens. Artificial Analysis had no speed data.
grok_4_7.reasoning: grok-4.7 rejects reasoning effort 'none' ('Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint and cannot be disabled'); 'minimal' still spent a median 829 reasoning tokens per scene.
grok_4_7.verdict: Rejected: about 18x slower and tamer. Its sex lines avoided announcing switches (8%) but read tentative ('Hold still, I'm finding the rhythm').

grok_4_3.why: Newest Grok that allows reasoning off: grok-4.5, grok-4.6, and grok-build-0.1 return 'Reasoning is mandatory' for both effort 'none' and enabled false; grok-4.3 and grok-4.20 return 0 reasoning tokens.
grok_4_3.method: Same runs as 4.20 with today's prompt.txt (which already has the change rule, so compare with grok-4.20 change-rule): 31 scenes x1, sex x3, nov6 x3.

grok-4.3: Your handprint is blooming across my skin.
This cradle has me open so wide.
grok-4.20: Deeper, god—your weight pinning me like this is perfect.
Fuck, your cheeks are already so red and hot.

grok_4_3.verdict: Not shipped: more varied in sex scenes but half as explicit there, more trigram reuse on her evening, and ~0.15 s slower. Mina rated Grok 4.20 best.

issue_2_sex_scene_switch_repeats.method: 8 real play-test sex events in order, 3 runs per model x prompt; 'switch' counts lines with switch/change/flip/again/already

prod: Switch it up, I want you on top now.
Flip me over, I need you from behind now. (for Passionate Cradle)
change-rule: Deeper, Tal—god, your weight on me feels so good.
Fuck yes, cradle those hips, I'm not pulling out.

issue_2_sex_scene_switch_repeats.shipped: The change rule went into prompt.txt's sex-scene section; most of the remaining 15% is the word 'already'.

issue_1_voice_moods.finding: MOOD_TO_DELIVERY_TONE had no entry for Fine, Happy, or WickedWhims' TURBODRIVER:WickedWhims_Mood_Sex (which _clean_mood didn't even strip), so 23/32 play-test lines and 29/65 Nov 6 lines got the generic 'natural, expressive, playful'.
issue_1_voice_moods.method: 10 real lines, same drama-3 voice, generic vs mood direction, Gemini picks the better fit blind (voice-moods.jsonl; clips in .local/exp31-tts/mood-*.wav)

results.Fine: lost 0/3 ('relaxed, conversational' sounded bored and robotic)

issue_1_voice_moods.human_check: Max preferred mood-0-mood.wav (Sex direction) over mood-0-generic.wav by ear.
issue_1_voice_moods.shipped: Sex -> 'breathless, aroused, moaning between words', Happy -> 'bright, cheerful, warm'; Fine keeps the generic direction; _clean_mood strips the WickedWhims prefix.

issue_3_repeated_interactions.method: Her real Nov 6 evening, 3 runs per variant, grok-4.20; repeat-hint adds `repeat_count` (same interaction for this pair in memory) and a prompt rule
issue_3_repeated_interactions.finding: Today's stack (Grok 4.20, prompt v3, cross-pair recent lines) already removed the Nov 6 host reruns ('Your table's ready' x3, 'birthday candles' x4 with Luna). The hint added flavor ('Same spot as last time?') but no measurable repetition gain.

issue_5_base_woohoo: Base WooHoo already gets 3 lines per act (the WooHoo transition social, bed_woohoo completing about 44 s later, and a drama reaction); her real Nov 6 play used WickedWhims Ask for Sex (3x), which the sex_scene poller covers. Her WickedWhims has only the preview animations, so scenes reuse a handful of positions.

animation_pack.installed: Anarcis' WW_Anarcis.package (290.5 MB, wicked.cc) in Mods/WickedWhims Animations: 2,254 animation entries, 210 CLIMAX.
bugs_fixed: Pack animations named by LocalizedString reached the model with an empty name; the mod now sends name_stbl and the companion resolves it.
The STBL cache missed packages whose mtime is older than the newest one (unzipped mods keep the archive mtime); it now fingerprints every source.
animation_pack.live: Two scenes on her save: Gentle Cowgirl (name_stbl resolved), Rigidly Rogered (roles tal -> gefen), Twisted Top (anal), lines matching each. No climax event fired; WickedWhims ended after the last position. Saves 38/38 restored, companion data restored.

issue_6_ratings: The mod writes {'type': 'rating', 'event_id', 'rating': +/-1} to events.jsonl; nothing reads it. Ratings join to reply rows by event_id (model, prompt_sha, language, event type). No ratings collected yet.
limits: Gemini judged voice fit; Mina hasn't heard the new directions.
Replays use fresh memory and English only; 3 runs per cell.
The 'switch' counter includes 'already', which is often fine.
